description: Source code implementing functional storage updates and inverse view operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including functions for applying updates to storage, computing byte sizes, and managing view inverses within the functionalization namespace.

classes.name: FunctionalStorageImpl
classes.description: A class managing functional storage with update capabilities, including applying updates and tracking storage size.

methods.name: apply_update
methods.description: Applies a stored update to the base tensor, reversing view transformations to produce the updated storage tensor.

methods.name: get_nbytes
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes used by a tensor, considering sparse and symbolic size cases.
